name: E-Commerce Development
heroSubtitle: Powerful online stores designed to help businesses showcase products, serve customers and grow their digital sales.
shortDescription: We build modern e-commerce websites with intuitive shopping experiences, product management and secure checkout integrations.
fullDescription: TOP TECH develops professional e-commerce solutions that help businesses establish and grow their online stores. From product catalogues and shopping carts to checkout integrations and order management, we create user-friendly shopping experiences designed around your business needs. Our goal is to make it easier for customers to discover your products, place orders and interact with your brand online.

benefits.title: Frictionless Product Discovery
benefits.description: Clean category filters, search, and clear variant selection help shoppers find what they need quickly.

benefits.title: Built for Mobile Shoppers
benefits.description: Touch-friendly product cards, fast image loading, and clear cart controls prevent mobile drop-off.

benefits.title: Flexible Catalog Management
benefits.description: Easily organize collections, pricing, stock visibility, and promotional banners as inventory changes.

features.title: Category & Attribute Filtering
features.description: Filter products by collection, price range, size, or availability without page reloads.

features.title: Persistent Shopping Cart
features.description: Slide-over or dedicated cart views with clear quantity controls and itemized subtotals.

features.title: Payment Gateway Integration
features.description: Ready for Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave, PayPal, or regional checkout workflows.

features.title: Order & Inquiry Notifications
features.description: Structured customer confirmation summaries and WhatsApp or email order routing options.

processSteps.title: Catalog & Checkout Planning
processSteps.description: We map your product categories, variants, shipping rules, and preferred payment methods.

processSteps.title: Storefront & Product Page Design
processSteps.description: We design clean product grids and clear detail pages that highlight product imagery and pricing.

processSteps.title: Cart & Payment Engineering
processSteps.description: We build cart state, checkout validation, and payment or WhatsApp order handoff.

processSteps.title: Test Orders & Store Launch
processSteps.description: We verify every checkout edge case across desktop and mobile before going live.

faqs.question: Which payment gateways can you integrate?
faqs.answer: We configure integrations matching your region and platform—such as Stripe, Paystack, PayPal, or direct invoice/WhatsApp ordering.

faqs.question: Can my store support both physical and digital products?
faqs.answer: Yes. Product catalogs can handle shipped physical items, digital downloads, or service packages.

faqs.question: How do I add or update products later?
faqs.answer: We provide structured catalog management workflows or headless store admin dashboards tailored to your team.

idealFor: Retail brands, wholesalers, and entrepreneurs selling physical or digital products online.

seo.title: E-Commerce Development — TOP TECH
seo.description: Online stores, product catalogs, shopping carts, and custom e-commerce systems by TOP TECH.
